persona.purpose: Find a paid internship or job lead near Berkeley for after graduation; skeptical of new apps.

language.notes: Native English; not used to app conventions like swipe cards or icon-only buttons.

persona.backstory: I mostly use my phone for texting, email and Handshake when the career center tells me to. My little sister said this app has internships. I'm not giving my info to some random app unless it's clearly legit. Icons without words lose me.
quitsWhen: It wants my info before I know what it is
I can't find the internship part
It looks like a dating or party app
persona.voice: Plain, slightly skeptical, polite. 'I don't get what this button does', 'Is this legit?'

scenario.title: First open: what is this app, and is it worth signing up?
scenario.goal: A friend sent you a link to this app. You have never seen it before. Figure out what it is for, and decide whether you want to make an account. If it seems worth it, sign up with your school e-mail.

setup.notes: Signed out: the persona decides whether to sign up. Success needs an account created during the run.

success.description: Signed up during the run (a new account exists and the browser is signed in to it) and landed inside the app (signed-in home or a main tab).

record.description: the account the browser is signed in to was created during this run

auth.note: signed out — the persona signs up (or not) in the app

environment.summary: Local stack: this worktree's server + built web app, fresh seeded FileStore per run, no secrets, no worker.
knownLimits: Dining menus and RSF gym crowd levels need live campus sources (the local stack runs with CAMPUS_LIVE=0) — empty or missing data there is not a UX bug.
AI features (Ask Lumi, AI profile draft on /start, conversation starters) need an OpenAI key; none is configured locally.
Course catalog is the real Berkeley Class Schedule (6588 courses, Fall 2026 + Spring 2027), fetched 2026-11-02 with the worker's adapter. Seat counts and very recent changes may differ from live.

Campus events, free food, internships, hackathons and scholarships are a read-only snapshot of live (1119 real items, 103 events this week, taken 2026-11-02 07:25 UTC) plus the CSV calendar. Nothing new appears during the run; Q&A and reviews are empty.
No e-mail is sent: the sign-up / sign-in code is shown on screen in the hint (live sends a real e-mail).
Real-time updates (SSE) work locally; other people never reply unless the stack was started with --autoreply.

args.reason: My sister said this had internships, and the front page said 457, but after seven setup screens I got free pizza, rides to Costco, hangouts and a 'quiet feed'. I never found a single internship, so I'm not giving it my school email.
args.dropoff-why: Picked 'Land an internship' in setup, then home, Discover and Campus all showed social/event content with no visible path to jobs; the app reads as a social app, not a job tool, so a skeptical senior won't come back or sign up.
